Save these prompts and use them to turn simple ideas into digital products. 1️⃣ PROMPT 1: EBOOK CREATOR 📚 Act as a professional digital product creator. Create a complete ebook about \[topic\], including a cover title, table of contents, introduction, 10 chapters, practical exercises, key takeaways, and a strong call to action. Make the content ready to copy and paste into Canva, using a modern, clean, and minimalist design. 2️⃣ PROMPT 2: SOCIAL MEDIA TEMPLATE PACK 📱 Act as an expert Instagram content designer. Create a pack of 30 carousel templates for the \[niche\] niche. Include the exact text for every slide, attention-grabbing headlines, engaging calls to action, and recommended colors and fonts to design everything in Canva. 3️⃣ PROMPT 3: COLORING BOOK CREATOR 🎨 I want to create a coloring book that I can sell on Etsy. Give me 40 original coloring page ideas about \[topic\], along with a compelling cover concept, welcome page, final page, and an SEO-optimized product description designed to attract potential buyers. 4️⃣ PROMPT 4: PRINTABLE PLANNER CREATOR 📅 Create the complete content for a 30-day printable planner focused on \[goal\]. Include a monthly calendar, weekly planning pages, habit trackers, goal tracking sheets, daily affirmations, to-do lists, and motivational pages. Organize everything so it's ready to design in Canva. 5️⃣ PROMPT 5: DIGITAL RESOURCE BUNDLE 💻 Act as a digital product strategist. Create a complete digital resource bundle for \[ideal customer\]. Include checklists, a quick-start guide, worksheets, a content calendar, editable templates, and additional bonus resources. Write all the content so I can copy it directly into Canva and turn it into a professional digital product bundle. 6️⃣ PROMPT 6: VIRAL DIGITAL PRODUCT IDEAS 💰 Act as an Etsy and digital product expert. Give me 20 digital product ideas that I can create using Canva and sell this month. Rank them from highest to lowest estimated market demand. Include a recommended selling price, ideal customer, and SEO keywords to help each product get discovered.
